question: How does the subclass initialization hook in the HTTP method-dispatching view class resolve conflicting methods attributes when inheriting from multiple parent classes?
answer: It uses `MethodView.__init_subclass__`, which runs at subclass creation and, if the subclass does not define its own `methods` in `cls.__dict__`, builds a union of the `methods` sets from all classes in `cls.__bases__` (adding `"head"` automatically when `"get"` is present) and assigns that merged set as the subclass's `methods`; an explicitly declared `methods` on the subclass always takes precedence over the inherited merge.
